.TH "NPM-SHRINKWRAP" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-shrinkwrap\fR - Lock down dependency versions for publication
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm shrinkwrap
.fi
.RE
.P
Note: This command is unaware of workspaces.
.SS "Description"
.P
This command repurposes \fBpackage-lock.json\fR into a publishable \fBnpm-shrinkwrap.json\fR or simply creates a new one. The file created and updated by this command will then take precedence over any other existing or future \fBpackage-lock.jso
